title: Spinach Gnocchi
subtitle: with fresh tomato and arak sauce
description: Potato gnocchi made with blanched leafy greens, served in a fresh tomato sauce with garlic and a splash of arak.

steps.text: Blanch the leaves in boiling water and cool immediately in iced water to stop the cooking. Drain and squeeze dry.

Boil the potatoes in their skins until soft. While hot, peel and mash until smooth. Immediately add the finely chopped greens, salt and eggs and mix well with a wooden spoon. Add 1.5 cups of flour, keep mixing, then add another 1.5 cups. If needed add the fourth cup of flour, but take care not to dry out the mixture too much. The dough should be very soft but firm enough to roll into ropes.

Divide the dough into 10 pieces and roll in flour into long ropes 2 to 3 cm thick. Cut into 2 cm pieces and flour all sides. Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil and cook the gnocchi in small batches so they do not stick together. They are ready when they float. Lift out with a large slotted spoon into iced water, then drain in a colander. Drizzle with a little oil so they do not stick.

Heat the oil in a large pan and lightly fry the sliced garlic until just golden. Add the chopped tomatoes and fry for about 1 minute. Add the arak and flame it (carefully). Add the tomato puree, the finely chopped fresh leaves, salt and pepper and cook until the sauce boils and the leaves wilt slightly.
Serve immediately, pouring the sauce over the gnocchi with a touch of good olive oil.
